topic: How a multi-branch operation manages payroll for four locations from one screen
format: Open with a SmartPRO Hub product capability, then show the real-world business outcome it enables
post:
One payroll run. Four locations. Zero spreadsheets.

A retail group in Muscat was running payroll across four branches through a combination of Excel files, WhatsApp messages, and a part-time accountant trying to hold it all together. Every month meant three to four days of back-and-forth, regular errors, and WPS submissions that sometimes didn't make the deadline.

SmartPRO Hub brought all four branches into a single payroll dashboard. Attendance, deductions, and allowances from each location flow into one screen. WPS files generate automatically and connect directly to the bank.

What took four days now closes in under two hours — and they haven't missed a WPS deadline since.

We built this because a business running four branches shouldn't need a dedicated finance team just to get payroll out the door. The complexity isn't a feature. It's the problem.

Our customers aren't paying for a sophisticated system. They're paying to stop doing things manually.

If you're managing more than one location and still reconciling payroll by hand, that time has a real cost — and it adds up every single month.

What's the one payroll bottleneck your team keeps working around?
